What is the slope of the trend line shown above?
feedback.worked_solution:
Notice that the trend line passes through the points $({x}_{1},{y}_{1})=(3,2)$ and $({x}_{2},{y}_{2})=(5,1).$

Therefore, we compute the slope $m$ of the line, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}m & =\frac{{y}_{2}-{y}_{1}}{{x}_{2}-{x}_{1}} \\  & =\frac{1-2}{5-3} \\  & =\frac{-1}{2} \\  & =-\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$
